name: nei like DNA glycosylase 3

function.text: NEIL3 encodes endonuclease 8-like 3. Annotated molecular activities include DNA N-glycosylase activity and DNA-(apurinic or apyrimidinic site) endonuclease activity. It participates in depurination and base-excision repair.
